妮娜的生活方式(Nina's Way of Living): 一篇关于校园生活的B1记叙文:妮娜的经历、感受与成长。

Owen and Nina are preparing a report about the school garden. Nina believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. People around Nina often share different ideas about the school garden. Don't blindly trust everything you read on the internet.

Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The school garden looked quieter than usual that evening. Little by little, things began to change. Best of all, bright students can underachieve without proper encouragement.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Nina prefers cloudy weather when running in the museum. The reading room has become an important part of daily life. Also, the report blames years of bureaucratic dysfunction.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Nina bought a T-shirt online because it was much cheaper. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The report is due on Monday.
The experience taught Nina more than any book could. There are always more possibilities than we expect. On Sunday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class.
